aboutpara: I'm a third-year student studying computer science with a mathematics minor at Northeastern University, with plans to graduate in spring 2027. I recently completed a Co-op at NExT Consulting building a WMS for Via Separations, and I am currently working as the head of web development at Northeastern Electric Racing where I lead the development of Finishline, our custom ERP solution. Additionally, I am a regular volunteer at The Unicode Consortium, writing code for their Adopt A Character program, and am the treasurer for the Alpine Ski Team. Currently, I am learning C and FreeRTOS to contribute to the embedded codebase at NER. I am always looking for ways to write software that solves real problems, whether that be warehouse management at a biotech company or bib detection for ski racing photographers. Non-technically, you will find me on the slopes of ski mountains, hiking through the woods, or in an obscure coffee shop in Boston!
